context:
Goal: banchi's and degen's waiting pages show their roadmap and items.
Why you: both pages sit on another account, so no cloud session can write them, and no session on your Mac is reachable from here (ListAgents, 23:16 CST: none). You only start the session; it does the work.
- banchi: the roadmap block is empty, while banchi's roadmap branch holds 146 steps.
- degen: degen registers a waiting page (LT2ST4u9…), but degen's roadmap branch has no waiting/ folder, so its data was never copied, and this account gets 404 on the page (lane export-after-page-write, 23:24 CST).
Steps: on your Mac, open a Claude Code session in each checkout, or tell each repo's page writer if one runs. Paste the line for that repo. Then press Done here.
banchi: Run skill waiting-page, step "Update the roadmap block", for banchi's waiting page.
degen: Run skill waiting-page: export degen's waiting page into waiting/ on degen's roadmap branch, then update its roadmap block.
ref: step roadmap-blank-pages; step degen-page-export; lane session_013NEJKyqU19UoQgbHWPzXBz; #1779; #1784
title: Ask a Mac session to fill banchi's blank roadmap block and degen's missing page data
